item.stem:
The diagram shows cross-sections of two transparent curved glass pieces, P and Q. Padma measures thickness from the middle to the edges of each piece.

Which classification is correct?

options.A: P is a convex lens and Q is a concave lens.
options.B: P is a concave lens and Q is a convex lens.
options.C: Both are convex lenses because both outlines look curved.
options.D: P is a convex lens because it is made of glass.
